Acme Ltd customer policies

## Returns
Unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

## Damaged items
An item that arrived damaged can be returned or replaced free of charge within 14 days of delivery.
Send a photo of the damage with the request.

## Refunds
Refunds are paid to the original payment method within 5 working days of receiving the return.

## Shipping
Orders ship within 2 working days. Delivery takes 3 to 5 working days.
